classifications.description: What a conformed column is, structurally. Derived from `ontology/column-annotations.json`; a column with no recorded role carries no tag rather than a default.
classifications.name: ColumnRole

classifications.description: Whether SUM() over this column is meaningful, and at which grain (analytics rule 11). Absent means undecided, never 'additive'.
classifications.name: ColumnAdditivity

classifications.description: The unit a conformed column's values are expressed in.
classifications.name: ColumnUnit

classifications.description: Personal-data class beyond OpenMetadata's system `PII` classification. `pii: direct` is tagged `PII.Sensitive` instead; these cover the classes the system classification has no member for.
classifications.name: ColumnPII

classifications.description: How a column or table came to exist, as distinct from what it means. Applied by scripts/openmetadata_sync.py from the repository's own artifacts.
classifications.name: DataProvenance

tags.description: Identifies a row or an entity. Arithmetic on it is always a bug, even where the warehouse type is numeric.
tags.name: Identifier

tags.description: A quantity intended for aggregation. Check its additivity tag first.
tags.name: Measure

tags.description: A value to group or filter by.
tags.name: Dimension

tags.description: A point in time; the grain of any time-series cut over this table.
tags.name: Timestamp

tags.description: A boolean or two-valued indicator.
tags.name: Flag

tags.description: Free text. Not a closed domain, not safe to group by.
tags.name: Text

tags.description: Summable across every dimension including time.
tags.name: Additive

tags.description: Summable across some dimensions but not time — a balance or a stock level. Summing it across periods double-counts.
tags.name: SemiAdditive

tags.description: Never summable — a rate, a ratio, a price per unit. Store the numerator and denominator and define the ratio as a metric.
tags.name: NonAdditive

tags.description: A monetary amount. Mixing currencies without conversion is a defect.
tags.name: Currency

tags.description: A cardinality.
tags.name: Count

tags.description: A physical or logical quantity.
tags.name: Quantity

tags.description: A proportion. Non-additive by construction.
tags.name: Percent

tags.description: An elapsed time.
tags.name: Duration

tags.description: A calendar value.
tags.name: Date

tags.description: Dimensionless.
tags.name: None

tags.description: Quasi-identifier: not identifying alone, identifying in combination. Masking it is usually the wrong remedy — generalisation or suppression at the grain is.
tags.name: Quasi

tags.description: Indirectly identifying through a join to another table. The disclosure risk lives in the join, not in this column.
tags.name: Indirect

tags.description: Inserted by a dlt load, not by the source system. Carries load provenance, never business meaning: never a measure, never a dimension to group a business question by.
tags.name: Dltsystemcolumn

tags.description: A dlt bookkeeping table (`_dlt_loads`, `_dlt_version`, `_dlt_pipeline_state`). Load history, not business data.
tags.name: Dltsystemtable

tags.description: Carries a conformed column contract: the same name means the same thing in every connector that supplies this concept.
tags.name: Conformedcolumn

tags.description: Realises one conformed concept for one connector. Its column list is governed by that concept's contract in `ontology/column-memory.json`.
tags.name: Adaptermodel
